eyebrow: Luvvent Events · From Vision to Reality
title:
Before the first
shubh moment.
sub: The lamps are lit. The jasmine is fresh. Somewhere beyond the doors, your favourite people are arriving. Let the celebration begin.

sections.name: The manifesto
sections.title:
Some moments deserve
the whole world to pause.
sections.body: A wedding is never just one evening. It is the quiet blessing before the music rises. The hands that straighten a dupatta. The welcome that feels like coming home. At Luvvent Events, we bring planning, imagery and entertainment together around what matters to you.
sections.visual: Ivory editorial spread; oversized serif quotation beside an architectural jali panel. Gentle opacity reveal.

sections.name: The celebrations
sections.title:
Many rituals.
One unmistakably yours.
sections.body: From the first colour of haldi to the last song at the reception, shape a celebration that carries your traditions and your personality in equal measure.
sections.visual: Three asymmetric arch-framed links for haldi, sangeet and wedding day. Hover underline; no autoplay.

sections.name: The invitation to imagine
sections.title:
An evening,
before it becomes a memory.
sections.body: Explore our visual studies in colour, light and atmosphere. Each is an invitation to imagine your own celebration—not a claim of a past commission.
sections.visual: Wide illustrated palace scene followed by a numbered editorial gallery teaser. Slow transform on hover.

sections.name: The first conversation
sections.title:
Tell us what
you are dreaming of.
sections.body: A date. A place. A feeling you cannot quite put into words. That is enough to begin.
sections.visual: Sindoor panel, fine gold rules and one clear ivory call to action.

title:
Your traditions.
Our full attention.
sub: Based in Hyderabad, Luvvent Events brings event planning, wedding planning, corporate organisation, photography, videography and entertainment into one considered conversation.

sections.name: Our philosophy
sections.title: Meaning before spectacle.
sections.body: The most memorable celebrations feel personal before they look beautiful. We begin with your people, your rituals and the way you want the room to feel. Then we shape the details around them.
sections.visual: Split spread with large 01 numeral and intimate illustrated diya still life.

sections.name: Our promise
sections.title:
A thoughtful host
behind every detail.
sections.body: Customer-focused planning means listening carefully, explaining choices clearly and keeping the celebration connected to your priorities. Quality-driven service means taking the preparation as seriously as the occasion.
sections.visual: Two generous text columns divided by a hairline gold rule.

sections.name: Cultural care
sections.title:
Tradition is personal.
We treat it that way.
sections.body: No two families celebrate in exactly the same way. Share the customs, languages, accessibility needs and family considerations that matter to you. We build the conversation around your version of the occasion.
sections.visual: Full-width crimson close, with small jasmine-inspired ornament.

eyebrow: The blueprint of a beautiful celebration
title:
Every detail,
in conversation.
sub: Choose the planning, storytelling and atmosphere your occasion calls for. The scope is shaped with you, then confirmed in a bespoke proposal.

sections.name: 01 · Planning
sections.title: The complete celebration.
sections.body: For hosts who want a considered thread from first idea to final farewell. Wedding and event planning bring the creative direction, preparation and event-day coordination into one agreed scope.
sections.visual: Two large editorial panels for wedding and private-event planning.

sections.name: 02 · Storytelling
sections.title: The feeling, preserved.
sections.body: Photography and videography turn passing gestures into something you can return to: the breath before the entrance, the first embrace, the room just before it fills.
sections.visual: Film-strip rhythm, three illustrated frames and handwritten-style captions.

sections.name: 03 · Atmosphere
sections.title:
Give the evening
its own heartbeat.
sections.body: Entertainment shapes anticipation into energy. Discuss music, performance and the flow of the evening as part of a celebration that feels like you. Corporate occasions receive the same attention to purpose and presence.
sections.visual: Dark stage-inspired band with concentric gold linework.

sections.name: Your commission
sections.title:
A scope built
around your occasion.
sections.body: Begin with full planning or discuss a focused combination of services. Deliverables, collaborators, venue requirements, fees and availability are agreed before booking. No standard package should decide how your celebration feels.
sections.visual: Plain-language scope panel with a single prominent enquiry action.

title:
A celebration
with roots. And wings.
sub: For the rituals you inherited, the people you love and the life you are about to begin.

sections.name: The family conversation
sections.title:
Begin with what
must be felt.
sections.body: Tell us about your families, your ceremonies and the moments you want to protect. We translate that conversation into a planning direction, an event sequence and a shared understanding of what matters most.
sections.visual: Two-column family-led narrative with a brass thali illustration.

sections.name: The wedding chapters
sections.title:
From haldi light
to reception glow.
sections.body: A joyful haldi. An intimate mehendi. A sangeet that lifts the room. A ceremony grounded in meaning. A reception that carries the night forward. Each chapter receives its own mood, while the celebration holds together.
sections.visual: Four numbered chapter links with warm colour transitions.

sections.name: The preparation
sections.title:
So you can arrive
fully in the moment.
sections.body: Discuss venue coordination, creative direction, vendor communication, guest flow and event-day responsibilities. The exact services and dependencies are documented in your proposal.
sections.visual: Quiet ivory close with an oversized arched outline.

title:
A little haldi.
A whole lot of heart.
sub: Sunlit laughter, henna-dark palms and the kind of afternoon that becomes a family story.

sections.name: Haldi
sections.title:
Let the morning
wear marigold.
sections.body: Picture a courtyard washed in turmeric yellow, loose petals and a comfortable place for every generation to gather. We shape the setting and sequence around the customs your family follows.
sections.visual: Marigold palette; low seating and sunlit courtyard illustration.

sections.name: Mehendi
sections.title:
The sweetest
kind of waiting.
sections.body: A slower rhythm. Music that travels between conversations. Thoughtful seating, gentle light and room for the bride to enjoy the gathering while the patterns take shape.
sections.visual: Jasmine-green accent and hand-drawn henna-inspired geometric detail.

sections.name: The personal details
sections.title:
Make room
for your people.
sections.body: Share your guest mix, preferred rituals and practical needs. Artist arrangements, décor, refreshments and entertainment can be discussed and included where agreed.
sections.visual: Intimate invitation panel with one button and generous breathing room.

title:
One more song.
One unforgettable night.
sub: The lights lower. A familiar beat begins. Across the room, someone is already on their feet.

sections.name: The sangeet
sections.title:
Every family
has its headline act.
sections.body: Build an evening around the performances, surprises and shared songs that belong to your people. We help shape the sequence so the excitement rises naturally.
sections.visual: Oxblood stage composition with a sweeping gold spotlight.

sections.name: The reception
sections.title:
An entrance
worth waiting for.
sections.body: The first impression begins before you enter. Consider the arrival route, room reveal, lighting mood and pace of the evening as one continuous welcome.
sections.visual: Wide architectural reception scene; restrained reveal on scroll.

sections.name: The rhythm
sections.title:
Leave space
for the unexpected joy.
sections.body: A considered running order gives the evening structure without making it feel rehearsed. Performance timings, speeches and production needs are discussed with the relevant teams.
sections.visual: Three typographic beats: Arrival / Reveal / Afterglow.

title:
For the occasion
only you could host.
sub: A milestone birthday. An anniversary. A family reunion. A reason to bring your favourite people into one beautiful room.

sections.name: The intention
sections.title:
Not bigger.
More personal.
sections.body: Begin with the person or moment at the heart of the gathering. From there, the mood, setting and sequence can be shaped into a celebration with its own character.
sections.visual: Intimate table setting illustration with candlelit gold accents.

sections.name: The experience
sections.title:
A welcome they
will feel immediately.
sections.body: Event planning, photography, videography and entertainment can come together around the scale and style of your occasion. The proposal defines exactly what is included.
sections.visual: Three spacious service rows with numbered markers.

sections.name: The invitation
sections.title:
Make the next
milestone yours.
sections.body: Tell us who you are celebrating, the atmosphere you imagine and the date you have in mind.
sections.visual: Cream invitation card on a deep red field.

title:
A room that
understands your brand.
sub: For the launch, gathering or milestone where every arrival should feel intentional.

sections.name: The brief
sections.title:
Start with
what the occasion must do.
sections.body: Introduce your audience, message and desired atmosphere. We shape an event-planning conversation around the purpose of the gathering and the impression you want it to leave.
sections.visual: Architectural grid and disciplined typography; gold accent only.

sections.name: The experience
sections.title:
From first welcome
to final conversation.
sections.body: Corporate event organisation can bring programme flow, preparation, partner coordination and event-day responsibilities into an agreed plan. Photography, videography and entertainment can be discussed alongside it.
sections.visual: Three-stage timeline: Arrival / Programme / Connection.

sections.name: The next move
sections.title:
Let the occasion
speak clearly.
sections.body: Share your event type, guest estimate, location and key dates. We will use those details to begin the scoping conversation.
sections.visual: Minimal executive invitation; no unsupported client logos.

title:
Before the pose.
There is the feeling.
sub: A held breath. A proud glance. The laughter just outside the frame. Photography and videography for the moments that make the occasion yours.

sections.name: Photography
sections.title:
The gestures
that say everything.
sections.body: Discuss the images you care about: family portraits, ceremonial details, candid exchanges and the atmosphere of the setting. Coverage, team composition and deliverables are agreed in advance.
sections.visual: Three editorial frame proportions; captions clarify concept artwork.

sections.name: Videography
sections.title:
Hear the evening
come back to life.
sections.body: A film can hold what a photograph cannot: a voice, a rhythm, the sound of a room responding together. Share your preferred storytelling style, then confirm coverage, edits and delivery timelines in your proposal.
sections.visual: Widescreen illustrated film still; no nonfunctional play button.

sections.name: The conversation
sections.title:
Tell us what
you want to remember.
sections.body: Let us know which ceremonies and people matter most, and how you imagine returning to the celebration in years to come.
sections.visual: Quiet full-width text with a small framed diya motif.

title:
You can feel it
before the first beat.
sub: The hush before a performance. The first note everyone knows. The moment an entire room becomes part of the evening.

sections.name: The mood
sections.title:
Music with
a sense of occasion.
sections.body: Share the sounds you love, the traditions you want to honour and the energy you imagine. Artist options, technical requirements and availability are explored during scoping.
sections.visual: Gold sound-wave ornament on a rich red stage-inspired field.

sections.name: The sequence
sections.title:
Build the anticipation.
Then let it rise.
sections.body: Ceremonial moments, family performances and dance-floor energy need different kinds of space. We discuss the programme as a whole so each moment has room to land.
sections.visual: Three vertical beats with a restrained reveal.

sections.name: Your evening
sections.title:
What should
the room feel like?
sections.body: Intimate and acoustic. Joyful and traditional. A late-night celebration. Tell us where the evening should begin—and where you want it to go.
sections.visual: Invitation panel with three mood words set in large serif type.

title:
The setting.
The anticipation.
sub: Explore photographs from our Google business profile, followed by three separately labelled art-direction studies for your next celebration.

sections.name: 01 · The Marigold Morning
sections.title:
When sunlight
becomes a celebration.
sections.body: A courtyard haldi study in marigold, sandstone and fresh green. Explore the preparations before the first guest arrives.
sections.visual: Bright courtyard illustration; asymmetrical 60/40 image-to-copy composition.

sections.name: 02 · The Royal Vow
sections.title:
A ceremony
held in warm light.
sections.body: A mandap concept in heirloom ivory and antique gold, with an architectural sense of stillness.
sections.visual: Centred palace arches with repeated diya motifs.

sections.name: 03 · The Midnight Mehfil
sections.title:
The night
is just beginning.
sections.body: A reception study in sindoor red, candlelight and the promise of one more song.
sections.visual: Deep crimson panoramic stage illustration; generous editorial caption.

eyebrow: Concept study 01 · Not a completed event
title:
The Marigold
Morning.
sub: A haldi imagined as a sunlit family courtyard: tactile, joyful and unmistakably Indian.

sections.name: The palette
sections.title:
Turmeric. Sandstone.
A breath of green.
sections.body: The concept uses warm yellow as an accent against soft architectural neutrals, allowing flowers, fabrics and the people in the room to carry the colour.
sections.visual: Palette swatches alongside a courtyard illustration; label all imagery concept artwork.

sections.name: Before the guests
sections.title:
The quiet work
behind the colour.
sections.body: Imagine petals being placed, cushions finding their corners and the ceremonial space receiving a final check. A behind-the-scenes sequence would capture those preparations before the family arrives.
sections.visual: Triptych concept storyboard: petals / seating / final walkthrough.

sections.name: Make it yours
sections.title:
What does your
morning look like?
sections.body: Use this study as a starting point. Your rituals, venue and guest needs will shape the actual design.
sections.visual: Warm cream closing invitation with a yellow border.

eyebrow: Concept study 02 · Not a completed event
title:
The Royal
Vow.
sub: An architectural wedding-ceremony concept in ivory, antique gold and the soft glow of diyas.

sections.name: The setting
sections.title:
Let the ritual
hold the room.
sections.body: An open, balanced mandap concept frames the ceremony without overwhelming it. Fine gold linework and pale textile layers give the setting warmth and a sense of proportion.
sections.visual: Symmetrical palace arch; still composition with no exaggerated animation.

sections.name: The final hour
sections.title:
Everything in place.
A moment to breathe.
sections.body: A preparation storyboard would follow the light check, the placement of ceremonial elements and the final review of family access. Religious requirements are confirmed with the family and their chosen officiant.
sections.visual: Three annotated preparation frames with editorial labels.

sections.name: Your traditions
sections.title:
Bring your own
meaning to the mandap.
sections.body: The concept is a visual starting point. The final setting must respond to your customs, venue and agreed scope.
sections.visual: Ivory-on-crimson invitation beneath a fine mandap outline.

eyebrow: Concept study 03 · Not a completed event
title:
The Midnight
Mehfil.
sub: A reception concept for the moment the formalities soften and the whole room leans into the night.

sections.name: The atmosphere
sections.title:
Candlelight. Velvet.
The promise of music.
sections.body: Deep red surfaces and warm brass accents create a mood of intimacy at scale. The visual direction leaves room for expressive florals and a clear view of the stage.
sections.visual: Dark panoramic illustrated ballroom with gold pools of light.

sections.name: The setup
sections.title:
The last rehearsal
before the room is yours.
sections.body: Imagine a behind-the-scenes sequence following stage cues, a room-lighting check and the final arrival walkthrough. Any production design would be developed around the venue and technical requirements.
sections.visual: Alternating wide and close storyboard panels with minimal captions.

sections.name: Your night
sections.title:
How should
the evening unfold?
sections.body: Bring the songs, the stories and the feeling you want your guests to take home. We can begin there.
sections.visual: Large serif invitation with a single gold-outlined action.

title:
The beautiful part?
You get to be there.
sub: A considered sequence of conversations, decisions and final preparations—so the occasion feels like yours from the beginning.

sections.name: 01 · The first spark
sections.title:
Tell us
what matters.
sections.body: We begin with the occasion, your people, traditions, location, dates and priorities. Early conversations establish what you need and whether the brief is the right fit.
sections.visual: Oversized 01 marker on a fine vertical gold timeline.

sections.name: 02 · The shared vision
sections.title:
Give the feeling
a form.
sections.body: We explore creative direction and service scope. A bespoke proposal sets out agreed deliverables, fees, responsibilities and relevant terms before a booking is confirmed.
sections.visual: Mood-board style type block and palette strip; timeline continues.

sections.name: 03 · The considered plan
sections.title:
Make every
decision count.
sections.body: Once the commission is agreed, planning develops around the booked scope. Timelines, coordination points and outstanding decisions are kept connected to the needs of your occasion.
sections.visual: Editorial checklist with abundant spacing, no fabricated countdown dates.

sections.name: 04 · The final countdown
sections.title:
The room is ready.
Your moment is next.
sections.body: Final reviews bring together the agreed event-day details and responsibilities. The aim is simple: a preparation process that makes space for you to experience your own celebration.
sections.visual: Full-width architectural reveal transitioning from ivory to crimson.

title:
A little perspective
before the big day.
sub: Thoughtful starting points for a celebration with meaning, atmosphere and room to enjoy it.

sections.name: Planning note 01
sections.title:
Choose the feeling
before the flowers.
sections.body: Begin with three words you want guests to use after the celebration. Intimate, joyful, ceremonial. Or vibrant, generous, unexpected. Let those words guide decisions when too many options begin to look equally beautiful.
sections.visual: Magazine-style opening with a large drop cap and marigold margin rule.

sections.name: Planning note 02
sections.title:
Give every ritual
its own breathing room.
sections.body: Speak with your families and officiant about timing, customs and participation before shaping the wider schedule. A beautiful programme respects the moments that should never feel hurried.
sections.visual: Two-column reading width with a pull quote.

sections.name: Planning note 03
sections.title:
Think about the arrival.
Then the farewell.
sections.body: How will guests find their way? Where can older relatives sit comfortably? What will people hear as they enter? Consider the whole journey alongside the visual design. Accessibility and comfort belong in the first conversation.
sections.visual: Three editorial prompts set beneath an arch illustration.

title:
Before we
begin.
sub: Practical answers for the first conversation. Your final arrangements will be set out in your bespoke proposal.

sections.name: Your services
sections.title: What can Luvvent help us plan?
sections.body: Luvvent offers wedding planning, event planning, corporate event organisation, photography, videography and entertainment services. Tell us which elements you need, and we can begin defining a scope.
sections.visual: Accessible accordion; question is a button-like summary with a visible focus state.

sections.name: Location & availability
sections.title: Can we discuss a destination celebration?
sections.body: Yes—include your proposed location in the enquiry. Serviceability, travel, venue requirements and availability need to be confirmed individually. We can explore the practical details together before a scope is agreed.
sections.visual: Single accordion row with plain-language answer.

sections.name: Investment & booking
sections.title: How is the investment agreed?
sections.body: There are no published package prices here. Your occasion, scale and selected services inform a bespoke proposal. Fees, payment schedule, cancellation terms and booking requirements must be agreed directly with Luvvent.
sections.visual: Single accordion row; no invented price anchors.

sections.name: First conversation
sections.title: What should we have ready?
sections.body: An approximate date, location, event type and guest estimate are helpful. Share a budget range if you have one, and any rituals or access needs you want considered. It is fine if some details are still undecided.
sections.visual: Final open accordion followed by a prominent contact link.

title:
The next
beautiful chapter.
sub: Tell us a little about your occasion. We will help turn the first thought into a more considered conversation.

sections.name: The invitation
sections.title:
A few details.
A world of possibility.
sections.body: Share what you know today. Dates and guest counts can be approximate. Your message stays in this browser until you choose to open WhatsApp and send it.
sections.visual: Two-step accessible intake form beside a crimson invitation panel. Clear progress and review before leaving.

sections.name: A direct conversation
sections.title:
Prefer to
speak first?
sections.body: Call Luvvent Events on 090902 19319 or email luvvent.com@gmail.com. Find us at 5th floor, Maruthee Residency, Sri Ramnagar Colony, Sri Ramnagar – Block B, Gachibowli, Hyderabad, Telangana 500084. Please call before visiting.
sections.visual: Large readable phone number on ivory; secondary navigation to planning questions.
